text: verify-attest needs at least a 300s timeout; a 120s default timed out mid-test-all and left a failed/dirty attestation artifact. Use longer timeout or run npm run verify instead of invoking the script directly without timeout override.

Self-review after implementation surfaced three contract gaps not caught by red tests: ReviewPage host-thread mapping, resolved composer locking, and orphan anchor state. Plan should reserve time for a post-build review pass as standard.
Staged verification took one retry after deleting the failed artifact. Final verify passes with 258 test files and 2986 tests.
